podcast.body: A song written by Roy Orbison that became a hit for the Everly Brothers. Orbison placed this song with them through Wesley Rose, who was both his manager and publisher, as well as the Everly Brothers'. "writing Claudette, which became a hit for the Avley Brothers."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
srcs.episode: Episode 83: "Only the Lonely" by Roy Orbison

podcast.body: Orbison wrote this song about his new wife, Claudette, and pitched it to The Everly Brothers, who decided to record it. Their version sold half a million copies, providing a significant upswing in Orbison's fortunes and earning him substantial money. "He decided to write a song about his new wife, Claudette, which he pitched to the Evely Brothers when they were honourbed together, on which they decided to record."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
